subject: S10 reopen fixed (18f0ec0): review_before_card + receive-time stats, review-id lock, ordered outbox, Stuck? registry, py-rounded intervals
body:
S10 reopen (20261117T002339) fixed in 18f0ec0 (single commit, integrated with the full gate: lint, typecheck, vitest, pytest unit 822 passed).
CI run for 18f0ec0: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43989861940
- lint/typecheck/unit/drift/models/build: success
- integration (db): success
- e2e chromium/webkit/firefox: in progress at posting; I will post the cards.spec result per engine when they finish and fix anything of mine.

1. MEDIUM review_before_card (defect 1), apps/api/naadi_api/cards/routes.py review_card:
   - After the visibility check, reviewed_at (already clamped to the server clock, 31-day max kept) < flashcards.created_at -> 409 review_before_card, nothing written. ui_copy cards.error.review_before_card (required key, defaults regenerated), web KNOWN_CODES.
   - Stats: "reviewed today" and the streak use the log's created_at (server receive time) instead of review when created_at - review > 24 h (CLAIM_TRUSTED_FOR). So a backdated batch counts as today, never as past streak days. Scheduling still uses the claimed time, and retention is unchanged.
   - db tests: test_a_review_cannot_predate_its_card (new card; -20 d, -2 h, -30 s all 409; no log or schedule row; a rating now is 200) and test_backdated_reviews_count_when_received (30-day-old card; 5 claims at -6..-2 d -> streak 1, reviewed_today 5; a -2 h claim counts when rated, midnight-safe). World fixture cards now have created_at = now - 30 d.
2. LOW review-id race: a per-user advisory lock on the client_review_id is taken before the card lock (fixed order, no deadlock). The log insert is `on conflict (user_id, client_review_id) do nothing`, and None -> 409 review_id_reused. db test test_concurrent_reuse_of_a_review_id_across_cards_is_refused: 5 rounds x 4 parallel requests over two clients, exactly [200,200,409,409], one log row.
3. LOW queue order: new cards/submit.ts submitReview reads readQueue(userId).length when its turn in the chain comes and enqueues behind waiting ratings. isRetryable (null status, 5xx, 429, 401) is shared with the replay path. vitest: in-flight rating failing with 503 plus a new rating -> both queued, in order [a, b], b never sent directly; a per-status table; online and offline cases.
4. Stuck?: renders only when features.assistant is on and a handler is registered via apps/web/src/assistant/ask.ts (registerAssistantAsk / askAssistant / useAssistantAvailable). The window event is removed. Contract posted to S14: 20261117T004342-seg10-cards-962137. vitest ask.test.ts.
5. routes.py docstring: clients may only SELECT card_reviews / card_review_logs.
6. Interval: computed in fsrs.ts from the unrounded decay factor with Python's round (half to even, pyRound). The off-by-one was ties: stability 2.5 at retention 0.9 gave py 2 vs ts-fsrs 3. vitest pins fsrs 6.3.3's _next_interval values. Golden vectors unchanged and green.

Local: db -m db tests/cards tests/db 220 passed; cards e2e smoke (webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440, --retries=0) 28/28 twice.
The reviewer's probe lives on the lead machine, so I reproduced its three server cases as the db tests above.
